items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Recovery merge in missionActivityFeed.ts now only fires when the current card is unambiguously about just the recovered command (commands.length === 1), preventing the described splice from destroying an unrelated coalesced card; regression test added per the request.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Pure in-memory reducer over already-parsed events; no I/O boundary touched.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches SQL/HTML, no secrets involved.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New test asserts on card contents (commands array, explanation, presence of a blocker card) not internal reducer state; covers the exact failure scenario from the bug report.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Added a single length check inside an existing branch; no new loops or unbounded work.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Comment style and guard shape mirror the existing 'Only attach when unambiguous' idiom a few lines above in the same file; missionActivityFeed.ts stays at 277 lines, under the 300-line convention.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized/on-disk format changed; this is a client-side derived-state transform over ParsedEvent[].
